GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased from barrier 6 lengths. well back turn. hooked Wide in Straight . battled away # 33
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn was hampered and taken out. Soon after straightening, over-reacted when slightly inconvenienced by a runner which was shifted out to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, running on took over 100m and drew clear # all honours

Jumped OK. Pushed fwd to lead on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & quickened @ 600m & pushed to quicken on inside (2L clear) on home turn. Pressured (3L clear) @ 200m & tired in last 100m but just held on. # Led - held on.
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. shared lead turn. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rdr advised that she was able to take up a position outside the leade without unduly pressuring her mount which travelled well until straightening. She added at this point her mount did not respond to her riding and proved very disappointing in the straight. A post-race vet exam of the gelding did not reveal any abs. Trn advised that in his view the geld had come to the end of its preparation and he confirmed that the gelding would now be sent for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. 3rd turn getting split 1 length. ran on well # Every Chance
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear. held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed passing 200m, kept on well just no match top 2 late # led/headed 200m
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 8 lengths. moved up Wide turn 5 lengths. battled away # Not Sighted
Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down 4th 5 lengths. looking for run turn. got to outside in Straight . ran on well # Every Chance
Jumped Ok up near lead early then Took A Sit overracing head up 2.5l Leaders back home turn 2 Lengths awaiting split Straightening Up looms likely 150m battled on well # keen early /solid
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After passing the 1400m got its head up and raced keenly for some distance when being steadied to allow another runner to cross.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 5 lengths. weakened. Never Likely # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was slow to begin and crowded for some distance after. Passing the 1400m had to be eased from heels. When quest re disapp perf, rdr advised that mount, which was stepping up in distance today, was under pressure from the 500m and in her opinion did not run out today’s journey. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
